style: Instrumental only, no vocals. Video game background music, loop-friendly, steady tempo, no long intro or fade-out.
jingle_style: Instrumental only, no vocals. Short game jingle for a cozy 2D fantasy RPG of endless dawn, light orchestral and folk instruments. The jingle itself lasts only 3 to 6 seconds at the very start, then silence for the rest of the clip.

tracks.town_dawnrise: Town theme for Dawnrise Village, a small cosy island village at sunrise where every new adventurer wakes up. Ambient and atmospheric, mature and wistful in the spirit of Hollow Knight's quieter themes: slow around 70 bpm, ocarina and felt piano over acoustic guitar, soft strings and a low cello line. Keeps the gentle, hopeful village warmth, simple and tender, calm and spacious, never childish, no music box.
tracks.town_dawnharbor: Town theme for Dawnharbor, the prosperous port city at the heart of the mainland, early morning over the sea. Ambient and atmospheric, mature and wistful in the spirit of Hollow Knight's town themes: slow around 75 bpm, soft cello and felt piano beneath acoustic guitar, flute and light strings, a gentle accordion line. Keeps the warm harbour-market tone and sea wind, but calm, spacious and reflective, never childish, no music box.
tracks.town_greenbough: Town theme for Greenbough Village, treehouses in giant oaks linked by rope bridges. Ambient and atmospheric, mature and wistful in the spirit of Hollow Knight's town themes: slow around 75 bpm, wooden flutes over harp, plucked strings, soft cello and felt piano, distant birdsong-like woodwind trills. Keeps the airy, verdant treetop tone, but calm, spacious and reflective, never childish.
tracks.town_lumewood: Town theme for Lumewood Sanctum, pale-stone towers with crystal domes in a glowing twilight forest. tracks.town_emberreach: Town theme for Emberforge, a disciplined forge town of stone halls, glowing forges and tall chimneys where knights train. A slow, stately military march in the spirit of Hollow Knight's town themes: around 80 bpm, a steady parade snare cadence and deep bass drum, noble low brass fanfare and horns over low strings and cello, ringing anvil-like metal chimes on the beat. Proud, disciplined and regimental, solemn and grown-up, atmospheric and spacious, never childish.
tracks.town_lanternfall: Town theme for Lanternfall, a hidden city and den of thieves and rogues, lantern-lit alleys at dusk. Ambient and atmospheric, mature and wistful in the spirit of Hollow Knight's town themes, with a noir edge: slow around 75 bpm, walking upright bass, muted clarinet and muted trumpet, pizzicato strings, soft cello and late-night piano, brushed snare and finger snaps, faint accordion and celesta. Keeps the sly, roguish swagger and charm, but smoky, spacious and grown-up, never childish.
tracks.town_driftcove: Town theme for Driftcove, a pirate hideout built from beached ship hulls in sea caves. Keeps the jolly, buoyant pirate warmth, but mellow, spacious and reflective, never childish.

tracks.boss_dawnharbor: Boss battle theme in a smugglers' sea cave near Dawnharbor, same harbour tone as the Dawnharbor theme. Cinematic boss battle music in the spirit of Hollow Knight's boss themes: dramatic, sweeping and dangerous, full orchestral weight with big low strings and cello, choir swells and heavy timpani, mature and serious, never childish: fast around 140 bpm, driving strings and acoustic guitar, urgent flute, accordion stabs, pounding drums, crashing sea-cave power.
tracks.boss_greenbough: Boss battle theme against an ancient tree guardian in Greenbough, same verdant tone as the Greenbough theme. tracks.title: Title theme for Tera's Dawn, a hand-painted fantasy adventure in a world of endless dawn. Ambient and atmospheric, mature and wistful in the spirit of Hollow Knight's title theme: slow around 70 bpm, solo felt piano opening into soft strings, cello and a distant wordless choir, a quiet hopeful melody with a touch of melancholy, sunrise over the sea. Grand but restrained, spacious and reflective, never childish.

jingles.jingle_quest: Quest complete jingle: a cheerful satisfied flourish with strings, flute and a light cymbal.
jingles.jingle_jobadvance: Job advancement jingle: a grand proud fanfare, full brass and timpani, a hero's new beginning.
jingles.jingle_death: Defeat jingle: a short gentle sad falling melody on harp and soft strings, not too gloomy.
